entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Switching a PR from Draft to Undrafted Borks CI #55655
  • `Replacement` mode is not the default when the shell is not detectable on Windows #55653
  • Agentic Triager does not Triage non maintainer issues #55652
  • Reconsider global.json sdk.paths precedence for dotnetup init root #55650
  • dotnetup: Test that dotnetup telemetry gets sent via the .NET CLI, and vice versa #55649
  • `dotnet watch run` times out at the _ResolveWasmOutputs step for a WASM project that targets net9.0 #55646
  • Solution Tools #55639
  • [macOS arm64] dotnet-watch cleanup hangs in Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true) #55636
  • HostWriter.CreateAppHost output differs from dotnet publish on macOS (missing ad-hoc code signature) #55635
  • Keyboard focus moves to "Installation Successfully Completed" text after close button but focus indicator is not visible.:Screen reader announces surrounding content along with "Learn more" link.: A11y_ .NET SDK and CLI_InstallationScreen_Keyboard #55634
  • unable to build VSIX-Extension project with 'dotnet build' - VSSDK1012 vs MSB3823 #55630

Closed

  • CI failing in `main` for `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Analyzers` downgrade on PRs not changing Analyzer Versions #55657
  • Add preview channel for dotnetup #55583
  • --local option is not documented #11958
    Backlog
  • ItUsesVerbosityPassedToDefineVerbosityOfConsoleLoggerOfTheTests hangs testhost with diag verbosity on FullFramework #54781
  • Set TransactionScope MaximumTimeout when API is ready #21101
    Backlog
  • Block `--help` (probably `--list-tests` as well) for MTP when not known by .NET CLI #50654
  • Add support to `dotnet reference` for file-based apps #55623
  • [Known Build Error] ProjectUpdateInProcTests.ProjectAndSourceFileChange_AddProjectReference timing failure #53661
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Watch.UnitTests.FileWatcherTests.NewFileInNewDirectory: flaky failure — file-watch event order (Add/Update) asserted exactly on macOS arm64 #55357
